content:
nina: FYI a community user opened an issue about the Ruby SDK retrying on 401 but never recovering in apps using connection pools. They posted a small repro in rails with puma.

peter: sounds familiar. quick workaround is to set `persistent: false` on the client or call `client.reset_connection!` after a refresh. Do we have a small maintenance PR to address this?

nina: I drafted a tiny fix: add `reset_connection!` to lib/redwood/http_client.rb and call it from the token refresh path. Test added to assert reset is called when 401->200 sequence runs. Kept it intentionally minimal.

peter: please add a changelog line "fix(ruby): reset HTTP connection after auth refresh to avoid pooled-socket hangs (compat Faraday/net-http-persistent)" and mark the PR `maintenance` so we can backport. Also add a short note in the sampleapp troubleshooting doc.

ci-bot: Created PR #307 by @nina  (private). CI: quick unit matrix + smoke job on ruby paths.

nina: included smoke job that runs a single auth-refresh scenario to catch this class of regressions. Kept job under 30s.

peter: nit on test: prefer `allow_any_instance_of(HTTP).to receive(:reset_connection!).and_call_original` rather than stubbing `request` internals. Otherwise LGTM.

nina: fixed test per nit and pushed. CI green on rerun. Closing after backport if release team agrees.
